::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 24th [after 1890]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear [Edmund](people/person_42.qmd),
Here is an entreaty I have had from [Mary](people/person_28.qmd). I can’t worry the old [Warden](people/person_1304.qmd), and I don’t know what niece is with him.[^1] I don’t think there is much to see extra at New College, but would you send her a note to make it possible. I think one sees the Hall naturally, and there was not much in the Library to see, but I suppose William of Wykeham’s staff is only shewn by special favour

Your affec
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. Edwards Sewell, Warden of New College, Oxford, lived with his sister Janetta until the latter’s death in July 1890.
[^2]: CMY's correspondent, probably Mary Anderson Morshead, evidently solicits entry to New College, Oxford, and its archives.  As a former fellow of New College and a schoolmaster at Winchester, Morshead would have had the necessary connections.
